en.content: In a class of 100 students there are 70 boys whose average marks in a subject are 75. If the average marks of the complete class is 72, then what is the average marks of the girls?
en.explanation:
Given that, total students = 100

and number of boys = 70

No. of girls = 100 - 70 = 30

Average of 100 students = 72

Total marks of 100 students = 100 72 = 7200

Average of 70 boys = 75

Total marks of 70 boys = 70 75 = 5250

Total marks of 30 girls = 7200 5250 = 1950

Average marks of 30 girls = = 65
